documentation.note: Architecture Scorecard is the high-level architectural maturity dashboard (capability-by-category status + Overall Architecture Health ratings). Keep it current alongside this file and docs/ProjectStatus.md whenever a capability's status changes. docs/releases/ holds one comprehensive, frozen-in-time document per released version (docs/releases/README.md explains the system) -- create a new docs/releases/vX.Y.Z.md every time currentVersion below is bumped. docs/templates/ holds reusable document skeletons (docs/templates/README.md explains the system) -- docs/templates/PreStageChecklist.md must be copied, filled in, and signed off (see docs/reviews/ for completed copies) before starting any new stage or standalone framework addition. docs/ImplementationLog/ (docs/ImplementationLog/README.md explains the system) holds one file per implementation phase (docs/ImplementationLog/Stage<N>/Phase<M>.md), created only when that phase's implementation actually starts -- convention established 2026-08-06 with nothing backfilled; the first real entry, docs/ImplementationLog/Stage3/Phase0.md (T41-T45, across three batches, batch 3 QA Decision: Approved), was created 2026-08-06 and is still In Progress (the original T44/T45 content -- PreStageChecklist sign-off, ADR-0018 -- remains open, see openQuestions; Phase 0's own acceptance criteria require the checklist sign-off before it can be marked Done). Standard matured 2026-08-06 (documentation-process-only change, no implementation work): the Reviewer Checklist grew from 8 to 11 items (added 'Existing design patterns followed', 'AI_BOOTSTRAP updated (if required)', 'PROJECT_STATE updated (if required)'); phase logs now require a 11th section, a formal QA Decision (Approved / Approved with comments / Rework required) gating documentation sync and merge; and docs/ImplementationLog/README.md now defines Canonical Document Roles (no-duplication rules across ImplementationLog/SessionReport/CHANGELOG/ADR/IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE) and Documentation Ownership (primary-editor assignment by role: Project Manager, Software Architect, Developer, QA Reviewer, Documentation Manager -- primary, not exclusive). See docs/ImplementationLog/README.md and AI_BOOTSTRAP.md for the full standard.

backendSubsystems.name: Stage 3 Phase 0 -- get_db() commit/rollback fix (T41-T43)
backendSubsystems.note: get_db() now commits on a clean request exit and rolls back on exception, before the session closes -- previously never committed at all, so every write silently vanished. Hard prerequisite for all of Stage 3 (every write in Phase 1+ depends on this). 5 new regression tests in tests/integration/test_get_db_transaction_policy.py, verified to fail against the pre-fix code (not vacuous). See ADR/0020 and docs/ImplementationLog/Stage3/Phase0.md.
